_help: Paid ads for the Rapid+ Blog. Add an object to the ads list, then run: node tools/build-blog.js and push. If no ad is live, the blog shows the 'Advertise here' banner instead. Fields: id, active (true/false), slot (home-top), sponsor (advertiser name), title (max 60 characters), text (max 120), cta (button text), url (https link), image (path like /assets/ads/name.jpg, 1200x630 or a GIF/WebP), from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, optional; the build checks them, so rebuild on the day an ad starts or ends).

_example.title: Acme Cloud Backup
_example.text: Encrypted backup for small teams. Try it free for 30 days.
